gloss: to have a weakness for; to be crazy about

definitions.gloss: to have a weakness for; to be unable to resist
definitions.explanation: To love something so much that one cannot resist it, most often food, drink, or a hobby; literally 'to have no eyes' for anything else. The object is marked with に: {甘|あま}いものに{目|め}がない (to have a weakness for sweets).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がない。
examples.english: I have a weakness for sweets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がなくて、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: My father is crazy about sake and always drinks on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がなく、⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまう。
examples.english: She can't resist cute stationery and buys some every time she finds it.

notes:
Literally 'to have no eyes' for anything but the thing in question. Always X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がない.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がない: to have a sweet tooth
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がない: to love drinking
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}がなくて: being unable to resist ~, (and so ...)

WATCH OUT:
- With a modifier the phrase means poor judgment instead: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{目|め}がない (to be a poor judge of people). Without a modifier it is always the fond sense.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧: to love — plain and general
- ⟦{喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}る→喉から手が出る：30832_nodokarategaderu⟧: to want desperately — acute craving for one thing rather than a standing weakness
